# A7 documentation

Experimental A7 compiler and language reference. Start with the relevant pages below. Retrieve the full corpus only when needed.

## Getting started

- [A7 documentation](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/index.md): An experimental systems language that compiles to Zig and native programs.
- [Get started](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/start.md): Install the compiler, compile your first program, and diagnose setup failures.
- [A7 tour](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/tour.md): Learn declarations, arrays, control flow, references, and generics through runnable examples.
- [Examples](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/examples.md): Browse every checked-in A7 example with source, commands, output fixtures, and related reference topics.

## Reference

- [Language](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language.md): Syntax, implementation qualifications, and evidence for the A7 language.
- [Syntax and lexical structure](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/syntax.md): Source files, comments, identifiers, literals, escapes, and punctuation.
- [Declarations and scope](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/declarations.md): Mutable variables, constants, initialization, aliases, and scope.
- [Types and conversions](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/types.md): Numeric types, inference, casts, compatibility, and nil.
- [Operators and evaluation](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/operators.md): Arithmetic, logic, precedence, assignment, and numeric restrictions.
- [Control flow](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/control-flow.md): Conditions, loops, match patterns, labels, and restricted fallthrough.
- [Functions and callbacks](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/functions.md): Declarations, parameters, returns, callbacks, and recursion restrictions.
- [Arrays, slices, and strings](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/arrays-strings.md): Fixed arrays, slice views, strings, bounds, and planned tensor work.
- [Structs, enums, and unions](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/aggregate-types.md): Structs, enums, unions, initialization, and payload restrictions.
- [Generics and type sets](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/generics.md): Type parameters, concrete specialization, type sets, and current limits.
- [Memory and references](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/memory.md): Allocation, references, nil guards, cleanup, and safety enforcement.
- [Modules and visibility](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/modules.md): File imports, aliases, visibility, and combined Zig output.
- [Builtins and keyword index](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/language/builtins.md): Current intrinsics, reserved operations, and the complete keyword index.
- [Standard library](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/stdlib.md): Every registered std/io and std/math call, its arguments, and current restrictions.
- [Compiler](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/compiler.md): CLI modes, flags, JSON diagnostics, artifacts, exit codes, and the Zig boundary.

## Project

- [Implementation status](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/status.md): Current support, known compiler gaps, and planned work.
- [Project](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/project.md): Contribute to A7 and maintain the shared human and agent documentation.
- [Release](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/release.md): Repository-root release commands, native artifacts, dependency audits, and docs gates.

## Agents

- [Agent usage](https://code5717.github.io/a7-py/docs/agent-usage.md): Selectively retrieve Markdown topics, feature metadata, examples, and compiler diagnostics.
